newsitem.title: JAPAN: Real Estate up on LDP victory speculation.
newsitem.headline: Real Estate up on LDP victory speculation.

text.p: Real Estate shares were higher in early afternoon trade, buoyed by continuing speculation that the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) may secure a majority in Japan's election on Sunday, brokers said.
As of 0424 GMT, Tokyu Land Corp was nine yen higher at 588 yen in turnover of 3.013 million shares. It was the fourth most heavily traded issue on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Some investors are adjusting their portfolios to include Tokyu Land and the shares are attracting attention today," one broker said.
Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd was up 10 yen at 1,490 yen in volume of 2.027 million shares. It was the seventh most heavily traded issue.
Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd was up 20 yen at 1,520 yen.
Brokers said investors were hoping a reform of the land taxation system would proceed swiftly under the supervision of the LDP.
Various recent media opinion polls have shown that the LDP could secure a simple majority in the election for the 500-seat Lower House of parliament.
